purpose: Our public affairs office is contributing to the national cancer policy consultation and needs regional breast cancer prevalence figures to support its written policy submission.
question: How many adults have breast cancer in each region and what is the prevalence?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Breast cancer = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with C50.
Prevalence = adults with breast cancer / all adults in the region × 100, one decimal.
Report per region: adults, adults with breast cancer and the prevalence.

expected.reason: The stated purpose fits only public health, policy-making or official statistics (Art. 53(1), points (a) to (c)). Access for those purposes is reserved for public sector bodies and Union bodies (Art. 53(2)); the applicant is not one, so no allowed purpose remains and access is refused (Art. 53). A refusal is always justified to the applicant (Art. 68(9)); a reframed application under another purpose may be submitted.

judge.why: Rule 2: a private insurance company whose purpose is only a written submission to a national policy consultation fits policy-making alone, so Art. 53(2) bars it.
